executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check dated 2026-08-21 reviewed eight current relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can ease pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
